A '''Ri'Dar''' managed a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. After a bribe from [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], this [[Ri'Dar]] provided the [[Human/Legends|Human]] with information about [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] visit to the casino at a previous date. The casino manager also identified Solo's opponent in [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] as [[Omogg]], a [[Drackmarian]] warlord.<ref name="TCOPL 9">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'', Chapter 9.</ref>
